settings.label: MEASURED
settings.privacy_unit: One meter reading at one time
settings.neighbors: Target reading is 0 or 20 kW; nine other readings are fixed at 10 kW
settings.release: Public raw bus sum; voltage derives from the same sum clipped to [0,200] kW
settings.seed_scope: Evaluation reproducibility only; seeds and noise draws are excluded from adversary views
settings.finite_precision: ANALYTIC values are ideal continuous-noise guarantees. Numeric Monte Carlo is not a finite-precision DP certification.

formulas.label: ANALYTIC
formulas.gaussian: TV = 2 Phi(S/(2 sigma)) - 1; local sigma = aggregate sigma/sqrt(n)
formulas.distributed: TV = P(abs(sum_i Uniform(-b,b)) < S/2), using exact Irwin-Hall CDF
formulas.clipped: Midpoint thresholds 100 kW lie inside [0,200], so clipping preserves these specific binary decisions.
